p: Pets Are Welcome | We are happy to welcome your traveling canine companions to our pet-friendly hotel in Buckhead. We offer the following for our furry friends on request: hypoallergenic Pet Beds and Pet Bowls. To participate in the pet program: Inform the hotel you’ll have a pet (or pets) staying with you at least three days in advance of your arrival. Keep in mind, only dogs weighing 70 pounds and under are permitted. | Pet Fees | Up to six nights | Free | Weight Limits | Individual pet weight limit | 50 | Pounds | Combined pets weight limit | 70 | Pounds | Maximum number of pets is 2.
